name: Haru
source:
The second sister of the three sisters working at Famille, a café on the outskirts of town.
She's also the manager of Famille and is mainly in charge of cakes and sweets.
She has a relaxed, gentle demeanor and is always smiling, which creates a good impression on Ren and Shou.
Even with a troubled expression, she goes at her own pace.
But actually, she's the most strong-willed and stubborn among the sisters.
She's catastrophically bad at waking up, and it's rarer for her to not be late than to be on time.
The cause is that she writes too much in her daily diary.

[spoiler] It’s not long until Shou witnesses Haru collecting a “soul”, however, which is a process where a normal human becomes a flower and is planted near the large tree. This has been the “rule” of this world for as long as Haru can remember, and it was her, and her sister’s jobs to perform this task to stay alive. As an angel of death, Haru is missing “memories” which was replaced by her powers. This includes memories that she shared with a boy named “Akito”, and memories of her sisters as well. The one thing she does not forget, however, is a promise that she made with Akito a long time ago.[/spoiler]


[Partially from [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2016/12/01/the-world-and-its-flowers-review-of-161125karenai-sekai-to-owaru-hana/]Visual Novels and Eroge Review[/url]]
